digest.component_or_area: RP-03 S3 T3 non-create dispatch coordination and fusing
propositions: Non-create operation families (update, delete, probe, clean-label, repair-property, conflict) must route through coordinator and fuse instead of legacy retry loop without dual-send or premature termination of historically successful work.
Deferral metadata (scope, reason, retry_not_before) must be persisted for matching plans while independent scopes continue, with exact applied/failed/deferred/skipped/recovered tallies preserved.

All legacy per-mutation guards (abort_check, HEAD-drift recheck, rebar-id audit) and batch preconditions (cross-project, blast-radius) must remain in force and unreachable for migrated families through the legacy ad-hoc retry nesting.

Coordinator cutover must be venue-gated with verified-fake Cloud and DC backend coverage asserting wire order, call ceilings, five-bucket tallies, and logs before the internal default flips from legacy to coordinator.
Historical replay of 1,200-run sanitized completed slice must prove zero premature termination of observed successful or partially successful jobs when normalized terminal outcomes are counted.
